title: STRling Conformance Fixture (v1)
description: Schema for shared conformance test fixtures in tests/spec/. Covers both IR fixtures (input_ast + expected_ir) and error fixtures (expected_error + expected_hint).

id.description: Unique fixture identifier, derived from the source filename.

input_dsl.description: The DSL input string to parse.

input_ast.description: Parsed AST node tree (present for IR fixtures).

flags.description: Parsed flags from directives (present for IR fixtures).

expected_ir.description: Expected IR after compilation (present for IR fixtures).

expected_codegen.description: Expected code generation output (present for IR fixtures).

expected_error.description: Substring of the expected parser error message (present for error fixtures).

expected_hint.description: Exact pedagogical hint string for the error. Required for error fixtures. Must match the TypeScript HintEngine output exactly.
expected_hint.default: Check the STRling documentation for help with this syntax.
